facts.fact: 维克多站在一扇金属门前，门通向 EON。
facts.anchor: VICTOR stood before the metal door.

facts.fact: 他事先就知道门槛后面等着他的是什么：死亡、那位医生、西德妮。
facts.anchor: He knew what lay beyond the threshold. What was waiting for him there.

facts.fact: 他把吸入器举到光下，看药筒里的紫色液体，算自己需要多少。
facts.anchor: He held it to the light, studying the violet liquid in the cartridge, calculating how much he’d need.

facts.fact: 今晚轮到伊莱，楼下浴缸里的冰已经在化。
facts.anchor: It was Eli’s turn tonight, the ice already melting in the bath downstairs

facts.fact: 维克多手腕上还留着住院手环的印子，来由是他自己那次失败的转化尝试。
facts.anchor: the ghost of the hospital bracelet still on his wrist, compliments of his own failed attempt at transformation

facts.fact: 这栋楼只有三层，跳下去不够高。
facts.anchor: And they probably would have, but the building was only three stories tall.

facts.fact: 屋顶上阴天，伊莱抬头看天，皱起眉，维克多撇嘴笑了。
维克多想，这也许是他一生中愿意住进去的那一刻。
facts.anchor: Of all the moments in his life, this might be the one he’d choose to live inside.
